acceptance_criteria: The V1R3 source remains COMPLETED/PASS with exact 30000 raw and 6000 effective frames, and every one of its 112 sealed files verifies before any teacher query.
Exactly ten teacher shards and 6000 globally unique labels are emitted, split tunnel train=3000 and garage validation=3000, with frame IDs and raw indices exactly equal to the source shards.

Every sample has one to six nonempty objective exits; 720-bin direction connected-component count equals exit count, branch-count class equals exit count minus one, and role semantics are internally consistent.
Both train and validation contain interior, junction and terminal roles; no sample, trajectory or label is dropped or reordered.
Complete-map, image and frozen-tool identities match; training steps, model inference frames, C09 reads and C10 reads are zero.
baseline: The approved 20-pose mobile-map feasibility audit produced nonempty, count-consistent labels on 20/20 poses. This formal run expands that fixed method to all 6000 samples; it does not tune against B0 or model outputs.

estimated_cost.compute: Serial CPU complete-map queries in the frozen ROS image; zero GPU, model inference, optimizer steps or simulation.

expected_evidence: Source-seal and complete-map integrity records plus the exact ten-shard schedule.
Ten teacher shards and summaries, a 6000-record teacher manifest, split role/exit histograms and full frame-identity audit.
Tunnel and garage coverage/representative label previews, raw logs, progress, final metrics, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.
method: For each sealed sensor pose, query the frozen height-conditioned layered complete-development-map oracle in the matching world. Emit 720-bin outgoing direction, decoded exit count, branch-count class and interior/junction/terminal role; preserve the exact sensor frame identity and raw index. Process ten shards serially and stop on the first ambiguity or contract failure.
question: Can the frozen complete AEE development maps provide unique, nonempty and internally consistent objective structural labels for all 6000 approved current-pose sensor samples without trajectory-future or model leakage?
stop_conditions: Any source seal, sensor shard, map, image, tool, count, split or frame-identity drift.
Any missing, ambiguous, empty, nonfinite or internally inconsistent teacher label, or a split lacking a structural role.
Any model output, future trajectory, training, C09, C10 or later sealed-world access; stop and seal without retry.

user_authorization.confirmation_reference: The user explicitly approved the AEE data export, objective complete-map teacher and three-seed head-only adaptation plan; this exact authorization is frozen in data card aee_structural_semantics_head_adaptation_v1.
user_authorization.scope: Objective teacher generation for exactly the ten approved AEE tunnel/garage trajectories and 6000 effective samples; current pose and matching complete development map only; zero model inference, training, C09, C10 or later sealed-world reads.
